projects.title: Library Test Coverage
bullets: Reproduced reported software defects in small public numerical utility libraries during a supervised undergraduate independent study on test coverage.
Documented test failures and fixes for the libraries, using Python, pytest, and Git within the supervised project.

research.title: Static Checks for Programming Exercises
bullets: Implemented syntax-tree traversal in Python for static checks on public file-processing example programs as a supervised student research assistant.
Documented false-positive cases in static checks for small programming exercises within the supervised faculty research project.
